description: This file defines a class and related constants for managing standardized form data in a visualization exploration context within the Superset project. It handles form data serialization, control standardization, and transformation between different visualization types.

classes.name: StandardizedFormData
classes.description: A class for managing and transforming standardized form data, including serialization, control extraction, and form data transformation between visualization types.

methods.name: getStandardizedControls
methods.description: Static method to extract standardized controls (metrics and columns) from form data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve form data for a specific visualization type from memorized data.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Check if form data for a specific visualization type exists in memorized data.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serialize the current standardized form data and memorized form data.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transform form data between different visualization types, returning new form data and control states.
